sentences.en: The drainage systems are not able to handle the water pressure.
sentences.zh: 排水系统无法承受水压。

sentences.en: Inadequate drainage can lead to flooding.
sentences.zh: 排水不足可能会导致洪水。

sentences.en: The new park has improved drainage to prevent puddles after rain.
sentences.zh: 这个新公园在下雨后通过改进排水系统来防止积水。
